chat._run_image_set + _start_image_set: fires-and-forgets a background task via asyncio.create_task; status progresses running -> completed and media is populated. End-to-end latency ~45-75s for 2 Gemini images (within the 90s budget documented in the request).

integrations GET includes 'github' with capabilities[] and connected=false when no gh_credentials row; coming_soon correctly no longer contains GitHub (now only Notion/Slack/WhatsApp Business).
